- [IRET.28.6.6.2] **P4.** Mutating the table during iteration invalidates
  indices (swap-remove reorders). The delete-while-iterating idiom is
  high→low:
  `for (i = oa_len(t); i-- > 0;) { ... maybe oa_del_at(t,i) ... }` —
  deleting `i` swaps `last` into `i`, which has already been visited.
